So, a lot of the bad reviews say that this didn't do a lot for their skin. I kind of agree BUT I loved it as an introduction to aha/bha exfoliation. This is super duper gentle. I noticed that when I use it every single day, my breakouts were fewer and farther between. I also like that it brings moisture back into your skin in preparation for serums! I will definitely purchase again. 4 stars because it's not revolutionary but it is nice on the skin and caused no issues!

I have been using this toner for over a year and I love it! I slowly started replacing my entire skincare line with all Cosrx products. Will never purchase or trust any other brand with my skin care. I have skin that will become incredibly oily by end of day and have the occasional break out before/during my period and this keeps that at bay. My skin look flawless every.single.day you guys. Just fyi- i do not have acne issues or sensitive skin and don't react to much of anything.

avis.titre: Thought I'd love it... but sadly didn't do anything
avis.texte: So when I first got this toner spray, I've heard many good things from Cosrx and heard this toner was a good choice is had good exfoliating factors that could help with my acne. A first I thought it was helping immediately but I'm almost done with my bottle and I don't see any difference. I also think that having the spray is kinda wasteful of the product than you could of concentrated a bit more if applied with a cotton pad or your hands. All in all, it's an okay product from my expereince and think if you're sensitive skin and have never used AHA or BHA gradually get yourself used it before using it everyday.

I use this product after my double-cleanse and before my serum/treatment stage in my evening skincare routine. I really like this toner, but my only complaint is the spray bottle. I feel like spray toners tend to waste product when you could easily just pour the toner onto a cotton pad. If you have sensitive skin or have never used AHA/BHA before, I would recommend starting off using it just 1-2 times a week, because it can be a little irritating. I've been using chemical exfoliators for a while, and I typically only use this every other night.

This toner is amazing at keeping my skin smooth and soft! I have to wear a face mask at work for 9-10 hours so I developed a lot of irritations, like many people! I started using this at night and I love the results. My pores appear smaller and no more mask irritations.

avis.titre: Calming and refreshing for combo sensitive skin
avis.texte: I use this after cleansing and prior to serums. It doesnt seem like much at first but with consistent use it makes a difference in the redness in the tzone area and acne. I have hormonal cystic acne and when I spray directly and concentrate with blotting with cotton pad at the start of something developing, often times the next day it is reduced in appearance or gone. If a troublesome area is particular, I also add Mario Badescu drying lotion and it goes away before it becomes raised. Prevention is key for acne scarring so this is now an essential step for me morning and night. I wish I had this product when I was younger!

This is my favorite toner!!! I love that it comes in a spray bottle so it's easy to apply. This definitely helps to reduce my acne. It doesn't dry out my skin and helps to maintain the oils on my skin
